fire:
The meeting ended late.
Raffaella thanked everyone for coming.

Chapter one is short.
Ruggero opens the shop at dawn.

That was the last song.
Raimund packed up his guitar.

We hope you enjoyed it.
Romilda will host next week's show.

The rain finally stopped.
Rasmus walked down to the harbour.

Thanks to all our sponsors.
Riquelme Foods supplied the lunch.

Doors open at seven.
Ravensworth Hall is on the left.

The vote was unanimous.
Rutger signed the papers that night.
